# mcp-server-il-benefits

> MCP server and agent skill for Israeli shoppers. Given a store and the cards and clubs the user holds, it says which one to pay with and how to use the benefit. Local-first, open dataset, a source link and a check date on every benefit.

- Homepage: https://github.com/ofershap/mcp-server-il-benefits
- License: MIT
- Spec: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 (https://agent-plugins.org)
- Transport: MCP stdio via npx

## Install

Use npx package `mcp-server-il-benefits` with stdio transport (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code).

## Tools

- best_way_to_pay: store (Hebrew or English), optional basket amount and channel. Ranked options, wallet first, with how_to_use, conditions, source_url, as_of.
- find_store, list_programs, wallet_get, wallet_set, add_local_offer.

## FAQ

Q: Which credit card should I use at a store in Israel?
A: Ask best_way_to_pay with the store name. It ranks the cards and clubs in the user's wallet and explains whether the discount applies at the register, on the statement, when loading a prepaid card, or later as cashback.

Q: Where does the data come from?
A: Official issuer and merchant pages, each entry with source_url and as_of. No scraping of apps or member-only catalogues. See DATA_SOURCES.md.

Q: Is personal data stored?
A: Only a local list of program ids. No card numbers, balances or ID numbers.

Q: Is the data complete?
A: No. Coverage is small and grows through pull requests. Answers say when a benefit is unconfirmed or old.
